args.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.profilenum, c.seg_category, c.geographyzone, cm.satisfscore, cm.casetie
FROM case_management cm
JOIN returns r ON cm.casetie = r.casenum
JOIN orders o ON r.srctxn = o.txnnum
JOIN customers c ON o.buyerlink = c.profilenum
WHERE cm.satisfscore = 1
ORDER BY c.profilenum
LIMIT 20;
